primary_text:
I gave my sister a tasbih bracelet for Eid. Beautiful, sure - but that's not why I chose it.

Every time she runs through her dhikr on it, the reward reaches me too.

A gift that keeps giving. Long after the wrapping's gone.

I buy two now. One to give, one to keep. Because every dhikr she makes, a little of the blessing comes back around.

The most rewarding thing I've ever given.
headline: Share In Her Dhikr.
